themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Crisis Emerging
themes_detail.summary: Missed Collection complaints spiked to 4 THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 967% surge (z-score: 5.21)—suggesting acute sanitation service breakdown in Morningside Heights, potentially affecting hundreds of households.
evidence: 4 Missed Collection complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (8-week baseline)
967% spike with z-score of 5.21 (high statistical significance)
Recurring CB budget request for 'new or increased sanitation trucks and equipment' suggests chronic capacity issues
reporting_angles: Why did Sanitation suddenly fail to pick up garbage this week? Interview DSNY supervisor and affected residents on specific blocks.
Is this connected to the long-standing CB budget plea for more sanitation equipment? Does the district have adequate truck capacity?

themes_detail.label: Residential Disposal Failures Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Residential Disposal Complaint reports jumped to 6 THIS WEEK vs. 1.9 weekly average—a 220% surge (z-score: 4.45)—indicating possible building-level waste system failures across multiple units.
evidence: 6 Residential Disposal Complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.9 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Concurrent spike in Missed Collection complaints suggests systemic waste handling breakdown
reporting_angles: Are multiple buildings experiencing disposal unit failures simultaneously? Check with HPD for DOB violations or housing complaints filed this week.
Is this connected to the missed garbage collection spike, or are these separate infrastructure issues?

themes_detail.label: Commercial Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Commercial Noise complaints surged to 93 two weeks ago vs. 25.5 weekly average—a 265% spike (z-score: 5.45)—suggesting new or intensified commercial activity (restaurants, bars, construction) in the district.
evidence: 93 Commercial Noise complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 25.5 weekly average (8-week baseline)
265% increase with z-score of 5.45 (high statistical significance)
No recent Reddit or news coverage suggests this is emerging signal not yet picked up by other outlets
reporting_angles: What new commercial establishments opened or expanded in Morningside Heights recently? Cross-reference DOB permits and ULURP applications (Hill Top Apartments ULURP is in public review).
Are late-night venues (bars, nightclubs, restaurants) operating without adequate soundproofing? Interview residents on Amsterdam Avenue and Broadway.

themes_detail.label: Elevator System Failures Widespread
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 33 two weeks ago vs. 9.0 weekly average—a 267% spike (z-score: 4.78)—plus a separate spike in ELEVATOR work orders (6 complaints vs. 1.8 avg, z-score: 5.13), indicating systemic failures affecting residential and public building access.
evidence: 33 Elevator complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 9.0 weekly average (z-score: 4.78, 267% increase)
6 ELEVATOR work orders 2 weeks ago vs. 1.8 weekly average (z-score: 5.13, 243% increase)
Dual signal suggests both complaint volume AND service request urgency are elevated simultaneously
reporting_angles: Are aging residential elevators in Morningside Heights (many pre-war buildings) failing at higher rates? Interview DOB and building code enforcement.
Is elevator maintenance backlogged across the city, or is this district-specific? Check if major residential complexes like Hill Top Apartments are experiencing failures.

themes_detail.label: Inspection Team Alerts Spike
themes_detail.summary: Special Projects Inspection Team (SPIT) complaints spiked to 6 two weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average—a 1100% surge (z-score: 7.78)—and Emergency Response Team (ERT) complaints hit 3 vs. 0.2 avg (z-score: 6.35), suggesting possible code violations, hazardous conditions, or major building violations discovered.
evidence: 6 SPIT complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score: 7.78—highest severity)
3 ERT complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35)
Dual activation of specialized inspection teams suggests serious code or safety violations in multiple buildings
reporting_angles: What triggered SPIT and ERT deployments 2 weeks ago? File FOIL request with HPD for inspection reports and violation notices.
Is this connected to the ULURP application at 1727 Amsterdam (Hill Top Apartments) or other major development in the district?
